WITH s AS (
  SELECT properties.$session_id AS sid,
         any(coalesce(nullIf(properties.$session_entry_pathname,''),'')) AS entry,
         any(coalesce(nullIf(properties.$session_entry_referring_domain,''),'$direct')) AS ref,
         countIf(event='$pageview') AS pv,
         countIf(event='affiliate_link_click') AS clicks,
         dateDiff('second', min(timestamp), max(timestamp)) AS dur,
         any(coalesce(nullIf(properties.$geoip_country_code,''),'?')) AS cc,
         any(coalesce(nullIf(properties.$raw_user_agent,''),'')) AS ua,
         min(timestamp) AS t0
  FROM events WHERE coalesce(properties.$host,'') = 'easternalignment.com'
  AND coalesce(properties.$geoip_country_code,'') != 'CN'
  AND coalesce(properties.$session_entry_referring_domain,'') NOT IN ('localhost:4321','127.0.0.1:8188','127.0.0.1:8765','localhost:8765','127.0.0.1:8931')
  AND (person_id IS NULL OR toString(person_id) NOT IN ('8435b8d5-16b6-5f4b-9b71-f5d4d196ad00','83b89204-633d-56fa-9e65-202e62d839ff','259d7d34-120f-50a6-a260-3e7fa192ae79','8b444548-d415-5d49-88b2-f717feaba288','b7575d9c-8453-5600-874a-47188ad98ec8','01a0b5bc-770d-7c62-b34d-5416ccb6f386')) AND properties.$session_id IS NOT NULL
        AND properties.$session_entry_pathname LIKE '/astrology%'
        AND timestamp >= toDateTime(1785340800) AND timestamp < toDateTime(1790561883)
  GROUP BY sid
)
SELECT toString(toDate(toTimeZone(t0,'Asia/Shanghai'))) AS day, ref, entry, cc, pv, clicks, dur
FROM s ORDER BY t0 DESC LIMIT 200
